Research position overview

Glasgow's School of Computing Science offers competitive funded doctoral studentships. Applicants should identify a research area and suitable supervision within the School, then follow the admission and studentship instructions for the 2027 competition.

  • Computing research

About University of Glasgow

Glasgow's School of Computing Science offers doctoral research and competitive studentship funding. Applicants choose research topics and supervisors within the School before completing the university's admission and funding process.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.gla.ac.uk/schools/computing/postgraduateresearch/prospectivestudents/scholarshipsandfundingopportunities/studentshipinformation/

Source: gla.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 31 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 31 January 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
